items.evidence: Log 1-49 builds an 8x master mix (106 water, 40 buffer, 4 dNTP, 2 pol) and gives 19 uL mix + 2.5 uL each primer + 1 uL template per well (25 uL), with the correct primer and template wells per fragment.

Comments record 98 C 30 s, 34 cycles with the j5 annealing step, and 72 C 5 min; log 178-277 adds 19 uL water, 5 uL rCutSmart and 1 uL DpnI per well; comments give 37 C 30 min then 65 C 20 min, followed by a pause for Zymo clean-up.
Log 280-418 adds 7 uL water, 2 uL T4 buffer, fragments 3/2/3/2 uL and 1 uL enzyme mix to each of assembly_plate A1:D1, giving 20 uL each.

Comments record a Golden Gate program of 30 cycles of 37/16 C, 60 C 5 min and a 4 C hold, then clean-up eluted in 10 uL; log 420-433 moves 5 uL into cells; 30 min on ice, 42 C 60 s, 250 uL LB+dextrose (log 436-443), 37 C 60 min and kanamycin plating are all recorded.

Every pick_up_tip in the log is followed by a drop_tip, and the final drop is at line 444. Fresh tips are used per primer, template, fragment and assembly. One-tip multi-well dispenses are only for shared reagents.

judge.summary: The protocol builds 25 uL Q5 PCRs, DpnI digests, 20 uL Golden Gate mixes and transformations with correct volumes, wells and order, as the log confirms. Off-deck steps (PCR, incubations, clean-up, heat shock) are documented by comments and pauses, and tip handling is clean.
